expectation: Membrane rings on B cells, DCs and macrophages/monocytes. Expect dense clusters in lymphoid aggregates or follicles (B cells, FDC networks) and scattered single myeloid cells in stroma. Weaker signal may appear on endothelium, epithelium or carcinoma cells. Overall frequency is moderate.
observed: A: well-defined bright aggregates in several cores, follicle-like in the D core, plus a dimmer stromal or fibrous signal in some cores. B and C: sparse, little signal. D: membrane rings around dark nuclei. E: CD40 is broad and reticular, partly overlapping CD14 (white), with green patches apart from it.
why: Dense membrane-ring CD40+ aggregates that look like lymphoid follicles are a specific, non-random population, even with some stromal haze in a few cores.
notes: Clear follicle-like clusters of CD40+ cells with membrane rings (D). Some cores show a fainter fibrous or stromal pattern. Row E is mixed: some CD14 overlap, but much CD40 sits in CD14-negative patches, which fits B-cell areas.
